sql:
with latest as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) q, captured_at from positions where captured_at >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'utc') and realized_pnl is not null order by market_ticker, captured_at desc),
ff as (select p.market_ticker, min(p.captured_at) first_snap from positions p join latest l using(market_ticker) group by 1),
st as (select o.market_ticker, string_agg(distinct o.strategy, ',') strategies, min(o.created_at) first_order from live_orders o join latest l using(market_ticker) group by 1)
select l.market_ticker, round(l.realized_pnl,4) realized, l.q, l.captured_at, ff.first_snap, st.strategies, st.first_order from latest l left join ff using(market_ticker) left join st using(market_ticker) order by l.realized_pnl asc
